title: Barbareño language
extract: Barbareño is a Chumashan language indigenous to the area in and around Santa Barbara, California. A dialect of the Barbareño language was also "spoken at San Emigdio near Buena Vista Lake" in the southern Central Valley. This dialect, called Emigdiano, "was heavily influenced by Buena Vista Yokuts". Barbareño lost its last known native speaker in 1965 with the death of Mary Yee. Both Barbareño and its sister language Ineseño are currently undergoing processes of language revitalization.
